editorial:
Imagine dying and finding out your whole life is on trial. That's the wild setup here. A firefighter named Ja-hong passes away and gets pulled into the afterlife by three guardians who act like his lawyers. He has to face seven trials over 49 days, and if he proves he lived a good life, he gets to reincarnate. The guardians fight for him every step of the way. It's a big, colorful adventure with huge set pieces, emotional moments, and a surprising amount of heart. The world-building is gorgeous, mixing fantasy with real human drama.

The acting is strong, especially the guardians who bring humor and warmth. The action scenes are flashy and fun, and the pacing keeps you hooked even during the slower emotional beats. Some parts feel a bit long, and the story can get heavy, but it pays off. If you love big fantasy adventures with heart, this is for you.
endingExplained: In the final trial, Ja-hong's biggest secret comes out. He accidentally caused his mother's death years ago, which he hid from everyone. The guardians defend him by showing his true heart and sacrifices. He passes the trial and earns reincarnation. But there's a twist: his younger brother, who is still alive, is in danger. The guardians promise to protect him, setting up the sequel. Ja-hong moves on to a new life, leaving his brother behind but with hope.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves big fantasy adventures with heart and stunning visuals.
